subject: Request: compress Wed exec demo to match CTO arrival window
messages:
From: Jordan Wu <jordan.wu@stellaris.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Menon <priya.menon@stellaris.io>
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick heads-up on Wed exec slot

Kim — quick update on logistics for the executive walkthrough we have scheduled for Wed the 16th. CTO just notified us his inbound flight has been delayed and the only reliable window he has on Wednesday is 1:00–1:30pm PT. He really wants to attend the exec summary but can only commit ~25–30 minutes.

Would Redwood be able to:
- compress the 45–60m session into a 25–30m executive summary focused on topline ROI + integration path, and then schedule a deeper technical follow-up with the SE team next week?
OR
- keep the full session and move it to later in the day / Thu if that works for your execs?

We want to make the CTO’s time count — tell me what you prefer and we’ll lock it.

Thanks,
Jordan
VP Product, Stellaris Health
(jordan.wu@stellaris.io)

---
Note: earlier internal note — Stellaris flagged this is a high-priority proof-of-concept request.

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Menon <priya.menon@stellaris.io>

Subject: Re: Quick heads-up on Wed exec slot

Jordan — thanks for the heads-up and for flagging the CTO window. We can definitely accommodate; high-level options below and a recommended path. Please confirm which you prefer and I’ll update the invite accordingly.

Option A (recommended): compress Wed 1:00–1:30pm PT into a 25–30m exec summary (topline, ROI, rollout risks & timelines), followed by a 60–90m technical deep-dive with our SEs the week after. We’ll provide a short pre-read and an 8-minute recorded condensed demo so the CTO sees the flow before the call.

Option B: move the full session to Thu (I have 2:00–4:00pm PT open) to preserve the longer format with live tech Q&A.

Option C: keep Wed slot and have our SE (Aditya) join the CTO portion only; then we do the remaining walk-through asynchronously via recording + doc.

If you’re leaning Option A, we’ll draft an exec agenda and push a calendar update today.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com

- 1:20–1:27: Aditya 7–8m condensed demo showing integration flow and perf numbers
